title: Intro to Prompt Engineering
description: Master the art of communicating with Large Language Models. Learn Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, and Chain of Thought prompting.

lessons.title: What is a Prompt?
lessons.content: A prompt is the text inputs sent to an LLM. It acts as the instruction manual, contextual backdrop, and data source all in one.

lessons.title: Zero-Shot vs Few-Shot Prompting
lessons.content: Zero-shot prompting performs tasks directly. Few-shot prompting provides one or more examples to demonstrate desired behaviors.

questions.question: Which prompting technique involves providing example input-output pairs to guide the model?
questions.explanation: Few-shot prompting provides example pairs directly in the prompt context to guide the model's output layout.

title: Generative AI for Creators
description: Unlock creative workflows. Master Midjourney, DALL-E, and prompt patterns for generating art, audio, and video designs.

lessons.title: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
lessons.content: Diffusion models generate images by iteratively removing Gaussian noise guided by a text prompt embedding.

title: Deep Learning Foundations
description: Mathematical systems behind neural networks. Deep dive into backpropagation, loss functions, activation curves, and vectors.

lessons.title: Neurons and Activation Functions
lessons.content: Activations introduce non-linearity, allowing networks to learn complex decision boundaries.

title: Computer Vision & ImageNet
description: Learn Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), object detection filters, bounding boxes, and large-scale vision indexing.

lessons.title: Introduction to Convolution Filters
lessons.content: Filters slide over pixel arrays to extract edges, contours, and texture signatures.

title: AI Safety & Turing Alignment
description: Address critical safety challenges, mathematical superalignment, agent containment bounds, and ethics guidelines.

lessons.title: The Alignment Problem
lessons.content: How can we guarantee that systems many times smarter than humans remain helpful and aligned to human values?

title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
description: Understand word embeddings, tokenizers, bag-of-words, TF-IDF, and initial sequence models like RNNs and LSTMs.

lessons.title: Vector Embeddings & Cosine Similarity
lessons.content: Words are mapped into multidimensional vector spaces where conceptual relationships resolve to mathematical distances.

title: Neural Networks from Scratch
description: Code backpropagation, gradients, and matrix dot products in raw Python using NumPy arrays.

lessons.title: Coding Backpropagation Steps
lessons.content: Compute partial derivatives of loss functions to update neuron weights.

title: Advanced Prompt Techniques
description: Learn system engineering prompt structures, jailbreak defense patterns, and API token budgeting.

lessons.title: Preventing Prompt Injections
lessons.content: Isolate user parameters from system execution guidelines to prevent malicious overrides.

title: Stable Diffusion & Midjourney
description: Master generating photo-realistic images. Control lighting, aspect ratios, seeds, and local Stable Diffusion setups.

lessons.title: Fine-Tuning Generation Seeds
lessons.content: Lock generator seeds to maintain structural details across edits.

title: Introduction to AI Agents
description: Build automated agent scripts using LangChain. Understand tool routing, loops, memory, and database actions.

lessons.title: Reason and Action Loops
lessons.content: Combine semantic thinking steps with physical tool executions in automated feedback loops.

title: Reinforcement Learning
description: Understand Markov Decision Processes, Q-learning, policy gradients, rewards structures, and environment maps.

lessons.title: Exploration vs Exploitation
lessons.content: Tune exploration probabilities to discover rewards while leveraging known paths.

title: Large Language Models (LLM)
description: Trace the transformer pipeline: embeddings, attention blocks, softmax classifications, and fine-tuning configurations.

lessons.title: Queries, Keys, and Vectors math
lessons.content: Mathematical projections scoring word dependencies across sentences.

title: Generative Adversarial Nets
description: Code generator and discriminator loops to generate hyper-realistic fake faces and art patterns.

lessons.title: Training Generator Loss Vectors
lessons.content: Balance discriminator capabilities to encourage generators to create realistic images.

title: Convolutional Neural Nets
description: Deep dive CNN pooling layers, kernel dimensions, stride margins, padding sizes, and feature extraction.

lessons.title: Strides and Pooling layers
lessons.content: Reduce resolution maps while retaining critical visual information.

title: AI Hallucination & Ethics
description: Understand why large sequence models hallucinate facts. Review metrics to detect and prevent errors.

lessons.title: Why LLMs Fabricate Answers
lessons.content: Next token prediction prioritizes grammatical likelihood over actual fact databases.

title: User Centered AI Design
description: Learn to design helpful system interfaces, user chat overlays, feedback sliders, and alignment parameters.

lessons.title: Designing Streaming Outputs
lessons.content: Increase perceived response speeds using token-by-token streaming layouts.

title: Transformer Architectures
description: Trace the transformer pipeline: encoder-decoder layers, positional embeddings, and multi-head self-attentions.

lessons.title: positional sine & cosine functions
lessons.content: Preserve text order information without sequential recurrence loops.

title: Creative Art Prompting
description: Learn key lighting variables, camera focus cues, and rendering descriptors to control image generators.

lessons.title: Controlling Focal Ranges
lessons.content: Specify aperture values (f/1.8) to blur backgrounds and focus details.

title: ImageNet & Large Scale Data
description: Learn to manage datasets. Explore data augmentation, crops, folds, and metadata tagging pipelines.

lessons.title: Random Rotations and Crops
lessons.content: Rotate and warp training images to increase classifier robustness.

title: Artificial General Intelligence
description: Assess definitions of machine sentience, test constraints, vector intelligence scale, and safety frameworks.

lessons.title: The Imitation Game & Beyond
lessons.content: Explore Turing testing guidelines and modern benchmarks for general reasoning capabilities.
